question: A square park has been divided into two rectangles of equal area. If the perimeter of each of these rectangles is 39 m, then what will be the perimeter of the square park?
solution:

A square park has been divided into two rectangles of equal area.

The perimeter of each of these rectangles = 39 m

**Formula used:**

Area of square = side²

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)
